story.title: Danny's Bicycle
paragraphs_en: There was a boy named Danny a new bicycle and told his mother , I want to buy a new bicycle. But his mother said you just bought a bicycle few months back. But Danny was persistent so the mother called his big sister to convince , Danny.

But Danny didn’t listen to, Suzi Then his mother called his father and discussed with him. Father said it’s fine, I will buy him a new big bicycle since he is growing tall. He bought him a neon bicycle. Danny was very happy, But he was careless and would park his bicycle outside the patio often

His mother noticed this and thought of teaching him a lesson. His mother hid the bicycle and Danny couldn’t find his bicycle, He got very afraid thinking his bicycle is stolen. He went around looking for it everywhere. He was in tears when he returned home and was regretting for being so careless.

sentences.text_en: There was a boy named Danny a new bicycle and told his mother , I want to buy a new bicycle.
sentences.text_vi: Có một cậu bé tên là Danny muốn một chiếc xe đạp mới và nói với mẹ: "Con muốn mua một chiếc xe đạp mới."

sentences.text_en: But his mother said you just bought a bicycle few months back.
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng mẹ cậu bé nói: "Con vừa mới mua một chiếc xe đạp cách đây vài tháng mà."

sentences.text_en: But Danny was persistent so the mother called his big sister to convince , Danny.
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng Danny cứ nằng nặc đòi, nên mẹ cậu bé đã gọi chị gái của Danny đến để thuyết phục cậu.

sentences.text_en: But Danny didn’t listen to, Suzi Then his mother called his father and discussed with him.
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng Danny không nghe lời chị Suzi. Sau đó, mẹ cậu bé gọi điện cho bố và nói chuyện với ông.

sentences.text_en: Father said it’s fine, I will buy him a new big bicycle since he is growing tall.
sentences.text_vi: Bố nói: "Không sao đâu, bố sẽ mua cho con một chiếc xe đạp mới to hơn vì con đang lớn mà."

sentences.text_en: He bought him a neon bicycle.
sentences.text_vi: Bố đã mua cho cậu bé một chiếc xe đạp màu neon.

sentences.text_en: Danny was very happy, But he was careless and would park his bicycle outside the patio often
sentences.text_vi: Danny rất vui, nhưng cậu bé lại bất cẩn và thường xuyên để xe đạp bên ngoài sân.

sentences.text_en: His mother noticed this and thought of teaching him a lesson.
sentences.text_vi: Mẹ cậu bé nhận ra điều này và nghĩ cách dạy cho cậu một bài học.

sentences.text_en: His mother hid the bicycle and Danny couldn’t find his bicycle, He got very afraid thinking his bicycle is stolen.
sentences.text_vi: Mẹ cậu bé giấu chiếc xe đạp đi và Danny không tìm thấy xe của mình. Cậu bé rất sợ hãi, nghĩ rằng xe đã bị trộm mất rồi.

sentences.text_en: He went around looking for it everywhere.
sentences.text_vi: Cậu bé đi khắp nơi tìm kiếm.

sentences.text_en: He was in tears when he returned home and was regretting for being so careless.
sentences.text_vi: Cậu bé đã khóc khi về nhà và hối hận vì đã quá bất cẩn.
